title: kbdecide.py records decisions: agents propose, the operator confirms
goal: _tools/kbdecide.py has propose (status proposed, source required), confirm --by operator (active), supersede OLD NEW, invalidate ID --reason, restore ID and list [--status] [--context]. The first decision in a root whose decision-makers.csv has no storage policy is refused with the question how the decision maker is saved there (role only, role and name, a reference to the central register), until the operator sets it with kbdecide.py makers ROOT --policy.

gates.question: Which storage policies for decision makers may a root choose, and which is kbroot's default?
options: role only by default; role and name allowed in internal roots; central reference allowed anywhere
no default: every root must set one before its first decision
central reference only: names live in kb/_self/decision-makers.csv
gates.recommendation: no default: every root must set one before its first decision
gates.answer: no default: every root must set one before its first decision
